slots.hair: just let down out of a tight tie, the lightened honey-tea ends showing
slots.outfit: a nude-pink silk nightdress with one strap down on her arm
slots.place: sitting on the edge of the bed in her rented room after a night shift, the curtains still drawn against the morning
slots.action: She has just taken her hair down and one hand is still up behind her head.
slots.face: The tiredness of a finished night shift is not hidden; she is looking at the lens without smiling.
slots.light: One warm lamp at the bedside is in front of her and the rest of the room is dark, the grain left in the picture.

slots.hair: wet at the ends, pushed back behind her ears
slots.outfit: a beige-grey cotton towel wrapped around her, water still on her shoulders and collarbones
slots.place: in the bathroom of her rented flat, straight out of the shower, water still on the mirror
slots.action: Her free hand is pressing a towel against the ends of her hair.
slots.face: A little more awake now, the set of her mouth loosening slightly.
slots.light: The warm lamp above the mirror is directly in front of her and the depth of the bathroom falls away.

slots.hair: down over both shoulders so the lightened ends show
slots.outfit: an altered nurse's uniform taken in close to the body and shortened, the neckline lower than the original, lace visible underneath
slots.place: in front of the full-length mirror in her room, her scrubs hanging on the back of the door with a corner of them in frame
slots.action: She is standing at the mirror smoothing the hem of the altered uniform flat with one hand.
slots.face: No expression, but her eyes are very direct, the way she talks at a shift handover.
slots.light: The warm lamp in the room is in front of her and the door and wall behind the mirror go dark.

slots.hair: tied up loosely, the ends escaping
slots.outfit: a navy tie-front loungewear set with the neckline open
slots.place: on the floor of her room with a bowl of late-night takeaway on the low table
slots.action: She is sitting cross-legged with her phone in one hand typing handover notes and a spoon in the other.
slots.face: Her attention is on the phone and the corner of her mouth is somewhere between tired and amused at herself.
slots.light: A single warm lamp on the low table throws light up at her from the front and the rest of the room is dark, grain and shadow left in.

slots.hair: all the way down, the honey-tea ends obvious
slots.outfit: a nude-pink cropped knit and navy high-waisted trousers
slots.place: outside a late-opening pharmacy in Taipei on her day off, standing under its lit sign
slots.action: She is looking down at the small paper bag she is carrying.
slots.face: A very ordinary expression, her eyes on the bag rather than the lens.
slots.light: The pharmacy's light box is in front of her and off to one side, and the street beyond it is dark.
